Sr. Front-End Engineer - Remote

We're looking for a senior frontend engineer to help build our customer-facing SaaS dashboard.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience with JS, React and TypeScript
- Experience with Next.js and GraphQL
- Strong knowledge of accessibility and web performance
- Experience writing automated tests with Jest or Cypress
- Familiar with AWS and CI/CD pipelines

Nice to have: design systems experience, mentoring junior engineers.

You will own the design system, improve web performance across the dashboard, and mentor engineers on accessibility best practices.
